name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a shaman, you face a highland spirit with flame and gather power to commune with fire spirits.
As a mage, you find that Kuramaa resists most forms of magic. Only fire magic can overcome the sprite.

faq.answer: Kuramaa is an ancient forest sprite dwelling in the Shen'dar Highlands. Local residents say it lives in a twisted tree stump atop a hill near the Highlands Anchor Pylon.

aliases: where turn in call of fire
faq.answer: Olariaan Swiftburn is a ritualist in the Gustberry Lowlands who sends you to confront Kuramaa. Olariaan needs the sprite's wooden mask for a sacred rite of fire.
Kuramaa dwells in a twisted tree stump atop a hill near the Anchor Pylon in the Shen'dar Highlands. Strike the stump's bark with a fist, and the sprite comes out to fight.
Kuramaa resists most forms of magic. Flame alone can pierce its defenses and bring the ancient forest sprite low.
faq.q: What is Kuramaa vulnerable to in combat?

faq.answer: Olariaan Swiftburn needs Kuramaa's powerful wooden mask to kindle an eternal flame and commune with fire spirits.
faq.q: Why does Olariaan Swiftburn need Kuramaa's mask?

faq.answer: No. Kuramaa is eternal. Its spirit endures after its physical form is defeated, then manifests again when called.
faq.q: Is Kuramaa permanently destroyed when defeated?

sections.body: People in the Shen'dar Highlands speak of Kuramaa, an ancient forest sprite that dwells in a twisted tree stump. The stump stands atop a hill near the regional Anchor Pylon. Strike the bark with a bare fist, and Kuramaa comes forth to meet you in combat.
sections.title: The Sprite of the Highlands

sections.body: Kuramaa's natural wards turn aside most arcane and divine magic. Only searing flame pierces its ancient bark and brings it low. Defeat the sprite, and its wooden mask is yours, an artifact of great power. Yet Kuramaa is eternal. When called again, it reforms.
sections.title: Fire and Wood

sections.body: In the Gustberry Lowlands, Olariaan Swiftburn awaits Kuramaa's mask. The enchanted relic is needed to kindle an eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire. Defeating highland nature spirits opens the rite's path to ancient communion with the elements.
sections.title: The Eternal Flame

summary: In the Shen'dar Highlands, Olariaan Swiftburn sends you to face Kuramaa, an ancient forest sprite. Flame can pierce its defenses, and its wooden mask is needed in the Gustberry Lowlands to kindle an eternal flame and commune with fire spirits.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
